description:
Hushfeed 0.30.1 tightens media handling and runtime reliability, then puts the product on the front page.

- Photo Mode files now receive stable index numbers, media jobs keep their deadline and clear-display captions leave as soon as their switch is turned off.
- Hook status catches more reflection failures. Shared callbacks report every failure without letting it escape into TikTok.
- Settings search, Feature Gate Lab, diagnostics and native pickers received another usability and accessibility pass.
- The README now leads with the approved H, real settings screens and direct links for adding the bundle, downloading it or checking compatibility. The hero contains no release number.

Verified locally: 1,045 runtime tests and 119 patch tests passed. Both Android API checks passed. The bundle verifier found 71 patches and three non-empty DEX payloads.

The `.mpp` file is the installable Morphe patch bundle. Keep Morphe Manager's existing signing key when updating a patched app.
